judged_text: The only spec added for Admin::EmbeddableHostsController asserts class inheritance (verified: this file's single it-block checks Admin::EmbeddableHostsController < Admin::AdminController and no other spec in the diff references this controller), leaving the controller's entire behavior surface unverified — the blank-category_id-to-uncategorized defaulting, the render_json_error path for invalid hosts, and create/update/destroy request handling have zero assertions. A regression in the uncategorized fallback (e.g. dropping host.category_id = SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id if blank?) breaks every host saved without a category and every embed-import's category assignment, and the build stays green because no test exercises the controller's actual behavior.
